messages:
alec (docs): PR #8145 ready for quick review  updates rate-limit & quota docs, adds a Ruby SDK snippet, and fixes the dashboard link. https://confluence.redwood/internal/docs/rate-quota-guide
sana (eng): Thanks. Which header did you use in the examples?
alec (docs): Switched to the product term header `x-rw-usage-plan` everywhere. Left a one-line migration note: 'Legacy header `x-rw-quota` maps to `x-rw-usage-plan`.'
toni (pricing): Please use the phrase 'grace credits' in user-facing docs (internal notes can mention 'burst' in parens). Also add a short line about tiered slabs: 'Tiers are billed per-token with slabed rates; see pricing CSV.'
marie (analytics): Dashboard panel ID changed last sprint. Panel is `usage_by_plan_v3` and metric name is `tokens_consumed_total`. Can you include this PromQL so readers can reproduce the chart?
marie (analytics): ```
sum(rate(tokens_consumed_total{plan=~"(free|pro|enterprise)"}[5m])) by (plan)
```
sana (eng): Quick nit for the Ruby snippet: use Redwood::Client.new(timeout: 30) to avoid hanging local dev scripts. Also mention that grace credits are consumed before plan quota and do not refill mid-cycle. Keep it one sentence.
alec (docs): Will update. Draft Ruby snippet included in PR, will swap to timeout constructor and add the migration + grace credit line. Snippet: ```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['TOKEN'], timeout: 30)
client.headers['x-rw-usage-plan'] = 'enterprise'
puts client.get('/v1/usage').body
```
